en.hubeali: Is’haq said, ‘Muhammad Bin Al Qasim Abu Al Ayana Al Hashimy, a slave of Abul Samad Bin Ali Ataqa narrated to me saying,

‘I used to go over to Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>). So I would get thirsty while I was in his<sup>asws</sup> presence, and I would defer calling for the water, and he<sup>asws</sup> would be saying: ‘O boy! Quench him’.
And sometimes I would discuss with myself for the leaving and be thinking with regards to that, so he<sup>asws</sup> would be saying: ‘O boy! (Get) His animal’.
en.sarwar: 22. Ishaq has said that narrated to Muhammad ibn al-Qasim abu al-‘Ayna’ al-Hashimi, the slave of ‘Abd al-Samad ibn Ali ‘Ataqa the following. “

Often time I would go to see abu Muhammad (a.s.). When in his presence I would feel thirsty but I would feel shy, out of respect for him, to ask for water but he would call the people of his household to bring water for me.
Often times I would think to myself of leaving and he would say, “Young man, bring his horse.”
